levels.surface: علي بن أحمد بن محمد الدقاق
أحمد بن يحيى بن زكريا القطان
بكر بن عبد الله بن حبيب

notes: the five co-transmitters at the opening are one level (alternatives); «[بن]» is an editor insertion in the text and is kept as written in the surface
«وَ سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الْإِمَامَةِ» makes the narrator the asker and «عبد الله بن أبي الهذيل» the one who answers, so he is the last link of the first isnad
«بمثله سواء» starts a second isnad with the same saying, so it is a route, not a variant; the Imam «جعفر بن محمد» follows «عن» and stays a narrator
